# opnsense_bind_primary_domain (Resource)

Zones BIND is authoritative for (**Services ▸ BIND ▸ Configuration ▸ Primary Zones**, plugin `os-bind`). Records are `opnsense_bind_record` resources; BIND only loads a zone that has at least one NS record (`name = "@"`, `type = "NS"`), which OPNsense does not add by itself.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_bind_primary_domain" "home" {
  domainname = "home.example"
  allowquery = [opnsense_bind_acl.lan.id]
}

resource "opnsense_bind_record" "ns" {
  domain = opnsense_bind_primary_domain.home.id
  name   = "@"
  type   = "NS"
  value  = "ns.home.example."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domainname` (String) Set the name for this zone. Both forward and reverse zones may be specified, i.e. example.com or 0.168.192.in-addr.arpa.

### Optional

- `allowquery` (Set of String) Define the ACLs where you allow which client are allowed to query this zone. Defaults to `[]`.
- `allowrndctransfer` (Boolean) Allow transfers via the RDNC key named "rndc-key". The key is shown in the general tab. Defaults to `false`.
- `allowrndcupdate` (Boolean) Allow updates via the RDNC key named "rndc-key". The key is shown in the general tab. Defaults to `true`.
- `allowtransfer` (Set of String) Define the ACLs where you allow which server can retrieve this zone. Defaults to `[]`.
- `dnsserver` (String) Set the DNS server hosting this file. This should usually be the FQDN of your firewall where the BIND plugin is installed. Defaults to `opnsense.localdomain`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) This will enable or disable this zone. Defaults to `true`.
- `expire` (Number) Set the time in seconds after which name servers should stop answering requests if the master does not respond. Defaults to `3542400`.
- `mailadmin` (String) Set the mail address of zone admin. A @-sign will automatically be replaced with a dot in the zone data. Defaults to `mail.opnsense.localdomain`.
- `negative` (Number) Set the time in seconds after which an entry for a non-existent record should expire from cache. Defaults to `3600`.
- `refresh` (Number) Set the time in seconds after which name servers should refresh the zone information. Defaults to `21600`.
- `retry` (Number) Set the time in seconds after which name servers should retry requests if the master does not respond. Defaults to `3600`.
- `ttl` (Number) Set the general Time To Live for this zone. Defaults to `86400`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the BIND primary zone.
